Job Description: 
 About DXC Bulgaria  
 We are DXC – a Fortune 500 global IT services leader.
 
 In Bulgaria, we are among the largest IT employers, delivering the full spectrum of the company’s diverse technical portfolio. Our teams work across cutting-edge technologies, contributing to projects that span industries and geographies.
 
 We foster continuous learning and professional growth, offering access to targeted training and certifications aligned with individual interests and career aspirations.
 
 Our culture of collaboration, innovation, and shared values empowers professionals to grow and succeed.
 
 We are now looking for Systems Infrastructure Engineer to join our team.
 
 D aily challenges 
 Participate in planning, development, and delivery activities, implementing technical solutions based on design specifications, operational requirements, and guidance from senior engineers where needed.

 Maintain and support infrastructure across cloud, virtualized, and on-premises environments, including Windows and Linux troubleshooting, configuration, patching, and routine maintenance.

 Configure, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines and critical engineering tools such as version control systems, CI/CD platforms, artifact repositories, and issue tracking systems.

 Automate recurring infrastructure and operational tasks using scripting and Infrastructure as Code, contributing to secure, reliable automation and deployment processes.

 Work with containers and virtualization technologies, implement, verify, and document low-to-medium complexity technical changes, and help improve system performance, reliability, and maintainability.

 Analyze incidents and recurring issues, contribute to root-cause analysis, identify sustainable improvements, and support infrastructure operations in line with SLAs and ITSM/ITIL-based processes.

 Provide technical support and consulting to internal teams and external stakeholders, assist with security scanning, vulnerability remediation, and open-source compliance reporting, and contribute to documentation, monitoring, knowledge sharing, and global collaboration.

 
 e X perience and skills required 
 Around 2 years of professional experience in system administration, DevOps, infrastructure operations, or a comparable technical role, supported by a bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.

 Good command of English as the working language, at least B2 level, with the ability to communicate clearly and collaborate with internal teams, clients, and other stakeholders.

 Practical experience with both Linux and Windows operating systems, including troubleshooting, configuration, routine administration, patching, and operational support.

 Working knowledge of version control systems, especially Git, as well as CI/CD concepts and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar.

 Practical exposure to Infrastructure as Code or configuration management, scripting with Bash or Python, containers, virtualization, and cloud environments, combined with a structured, analytical, and reliable working style.

 Experience and skills that would be considered as an advantage: 
 Experience with Terraform, especially in AWS environments, and AWS services beyond basic compute, such as IAM, networking, storage, monitoring, or security-related services.

 Understanding of networking basics, including VPN, DNS, firewalls, routing, load balancing, and certificates, plus familiarity with infrastructure security scanning, vulnerability management, open-source compliance reporting, Agile or Scrum methodologies, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, or the insurance domain.

 
 C ompany benefits 
 At DXC Technology, we don’t just offer jobs - we build careers. Here’s what you can look forward to when you join us:
 Enjoy competitive compensation and grow your career in a fast-paced, international environment.

 Benefit from 24 days of paid vacation to rest, explore, and recharge - plus comprehensive medical and life insurance, and monthly food vouchers to support your lifestyle.

 Access premium learning platforms, get company-sponsored certifications, and grow your skills with continuous development opportunities tailored to you.

 Get recognized through our Employee Recognition Program - your contributions deserve the spotlight.

 Refer great talent through our Employee Referral Program and get rewarded for helping shape our future.

 Enjoy discounts and special offers with your employee badge - it pays to be part of the team.

 Access 24/7 support for you and your family, with a wide range of wellbeing resources to help you thrive.

 Join meaningful initiatives that give back to the community and connect you with like-minded colleagues through fun and impactful experiences.

 
At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.
 
 If you feel comfortable with the above-mentioned requirements, please send us your CV in English.
 Please note only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
 
 DXC Technology stands for equal opportunities, namely, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation.  All recruitment decisions are based solely on qualifications, skills, knowledge and experience, and relevant business requirements.

 Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. More information on employment scams is available   here .
